description: NaBiS₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent BiS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.92 Å. Bi³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form BiS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent BiS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. All Bi-S bond lengths are 2.84 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Bi³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Bi₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
